correctness.rationale: For the given reversible four-state Laplacian, direct substitution checks four eigenvalues 0,p,2-p,2 with the supplied eigenfunctions. Weighted squared eigenvector norms yield exact corner probabilities a=(1-p)/(2(2-p)) for 0,2 and b=1/(2(2-p)) for p,2-p, summing to one. Tensor-product diagonalization of the normalized d-fold Cartesian sum gives the independent-average corner law and sign-pair parametrization lambda_{S,T}=1+(pS+(2-p)T)/(2d), where S,T range over d+1 parity-constrained integers: hence <=(d+1)^2 distinct active atoms for all 0<p<1. If p irrational, equality of eigenvalues forces both integer differences zero. At p=1/2 the integers i+3j (0<=i,j<=d) run through 0..4d for d>=2, giving 4d+1 and exactly 21 for d=5. The cyclic subspace span{P_lambda e_corner} contains the constant zero eigenstate and is invariant under the rank-one oracle, yielding exact diag-minus-qq* Hamiltonian and resolvent. Independently checked one-site matrix eigendata for several rational p and analyzed the d=1 boundary and collision argument; finite script checks are supplementary.
residual_risks: For rational p, only general quadratic bound (except p=1/2) is claimed; not universal (d+1)^2 equality.
This gives exact active-space reduction, not optimal Grover parameters, hitting times or asymptotic speedup.
